annotations.evidence: the maintainer's print read 2026-10-22: "(and the plural `קַיִּין`?)   Same issue as above, and yes the plural as well." S00308 and S00878 (`pl. קֵיוָן, v. קַוָּא`) spell `קַוָּא`, which two companion patches move here from S00217 `קוּא`; the entry's own `cmp. כַּוָּא` agrees; it stands between S00215 `קַו` and S00217, where `קוא` sorts and `קיא` does not. 1323a · leaf 646.
